sentences: I turn the soil with a fork and mix in two buckets of compost from the bin.
I plant the tomato seeds one inch deep in rows spaced eighteen inches apart.
I water the raised beds every morning using a watering can filled from the rain barrel.
I pull weeds by hand from the flower bed and drop them into a bucket.
I prune the dead branches from the rose bushes with bypass shears each spring.
I spread a two-inch layer of wood chips around the base of the blueberry plants.
I apply a balanced fertilizer to the vegetable patch according to the package directions.
I check the undersides of leaves for aphids and wash them off with a spray bottle.
I pick ripe tomatoes from the vine and place them in a basket on the porch.
I add kitchen scraps and dry leaves to the compost pile and turn it with a pitchfork.
I clean the rust off my trowel and pruners with a wire brush and oil them.
I tie the tomato stems to wooden stakes with soft twine to keep them upright.
I remove spent blooms from the marigolds by pinching them off with my thumb and forefinger.
I transplant the leggy seedlings into larger pots filled with fresh potting mix.
I stick my finger into the soil to check if it is dry before watering again.
I rake fallen leaves from the lawn into a pile near the fence.
I mow the grass with a push mower set to a three-inch cutting height.
I trim the edges of the garden bed with a half-moon edger to keep a crisp line.
I wrap burlap around the young citrus tree trunk to protect it from frost.
I start pepper seeds indoors under a grow light six weeks before the last frost.
